items.name: Priya Sharma
items.text: Dr. Anmol is absolutely wonderful! I was terrified of the dentist, but his gentle approach and clear explanations put me completely at ease. My dental implant looks and feels completely natural. Best decision I ever made!

items.name: Rahul Gupta
items.text: The consultation was thorough and professional. Dr. Anmol explained the entire procedure for my root canal in detail, and the treatment itself was surprisingly painless. The clinic is spotless and follow-up care was excellent.

items.name: Sneha Rawat
items.text: Professional, punctual, and very skilled. I went in for a complex extraction and crown. Everything went smoothly. I highly recommend Dr. Anmol for anyone looking for quality dental work in Indore.

items.name: Amit Trivedi
items.text: Infinity Dental Clinic is the best in Vijay Nagar. Had my smile makeover here and the results are amazing. Dr. Anmol really takes his time to get everything perfect. Worth every rupee!

items.name: Kavita Singh
items.text: Really impressed with the hygiene standards and the modern equipment. Dr. Anmol is soft-spoken and very patient. He explained things to me that other dentists never mentioned. 5 stars!

items.name: Vikram Patel
items.text: Excellent service and results for my whitening treatment. The only minor thing was a bit of a wait, but it was because the doctor was being so thorough with the previous patient. Highly recommended.
